principle: The Universal Control coordinates capabilities; it does not become a second authority for every capability it surfaces.

navigation.shell_role: project semantic page state into selector, URL and PAGE HOST
navigation.must_not: let URL, iframe and selector independently become competing route authorities

favorites.shell_role: pin/unpin, order and render stable page_id values
favorites.cutover_rule: no DB read authority until explicit P3 migration/rollback gates pass

capture_notes.shell_role: invoke capture and display local note state
capture_notes.owner_boundary: existing VoiceQueue/note store; P4 Capture remains cross-product owner
capture_notes.sync: durable id outbox + remote-relevant fingerprints; unchanged notes are not resent
capture_notes.must_not: make page navigation or local save wait for network

context_patent.shell_role: request prepared context and render/copy result
context_patent.must_not: encode transport/Patent mechanics in UI navigation code

identity_link.must_not: treat the selector itself as identity/session authority

preferences.shell_role: consume semantic preferences such as corner
preferences.must_not: persist pixel coordinates for semantic corner placement

backend_health.visibility: diagnostic by default; user-facing only when an action materially depends on it

global_invariants: PAGE HOST child pages never mount duplicate Prometeo global UI
local actions remain usable without network
recording/transcription survives selector movement and page navigation
Corner Anchor keeps the same physical/navigation grammar
Current/Human Accepted/Served are never inferred from candidate recency
each persistence ownership change is additive, idempotent, parity-verified and rollbackable
one subsystem cutover per promotion boundary
promotion: Golden Master parity first; architecture improvement alone is insufficient for Served authority.
